theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose light, dark or system appearance for the backoffice.

hero.title: Manage every store detail before opening the doors.
hero.description: Sales, inventory, suppliers, customers and cash close in one focused workspace for local retail teams.

form.title: Welcome back
form.description: Sign in to continue to the store command center.

bullets: Guided reset in a few steps

request.heroDescription: A clear flow to restore access without interrupting store operations.
request.title: Recover password
request.description: Enter the email used to access the store dashboard. We will send a temporary code to continue.

code.heroDescription: Code verification reduces the risk of unauthorized access to the admin panel.
code.title: Verify code
code.description: Enter the code sent to finance@store.com. The code expires in 10 minutes.

reset.heroDescription: The system guides minimum requirements before returning to the dashboard.
reset.title: Create new password
reset.description: Set a strong password to protect orders, inventory, cash register and store reports.
reset.hint: Use at least 8 characters with a number and an uppercase letter.

success.heroDescription: A simple confirmation closes the flow and makes the next step clear.
success.title: Password updated
success.description: The new password is active. You can return to the dashboard and continue store operations.

address.title: Store address
address.lookupIdle: Enter the full ZIP code to fill the address.
address.lookupNotFound: ZIP code not found. Fill the address manually.

preferences.title: Operation preferences
preferences.helper: Opening time must be earlier than closing time.

completed.title: Onboarding completed
completed.successDescription: Your store is ready to use.
